component.name: Doremi
component.summary: Cliente de escritorio para YouTube Music

description.p: Doremi is an elegant desktop client for YouTube Music on Linux. It combines a native interface built with Qt 6 and a high-performance Rust backend to deliver a smooth, feature-rich music experience.

Doremi es un cliente de escritorio elegante para YouTube Music en Linux. Combina una interfaz nativa construida con Qt 6 y un backend de alto rendimiento en Rust para ofrecer una experiencia musical fluida y completa.

ul.li: Full YouTube Music integration: search, browse, library, playlists and more
High-quality audio playback with VLC, including equalizer and crossfade
Synchronized lyrics with auto-scroll and seek-by-line
Download music for offline listening via yt-dlp
Last.fm scrobbling and Discord Rich Presence
MPRIS integration, media keys and system tray
Dark and light themes with customizable accent colors

description.p: First public beta release of Doremi.
Primera versión beta pública de Doremi.

ul.li: Full YouTube Music API integration (search, browse, library, playlists)
VLC-based audio playback with equalizer, crossfade and gapless
Download support via yt-dlp with batch downloads
